knownUnresolvedFinding.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Normalize unvalidated units before hashing receipt identity**

Fresh evidence in the repaired head shows another reframing path: `semanticReceipt` hashes the entire copied inspection, including `resources.units`, but validation later only requires that field to be a string. An importer can change it to any equal-byte-length string so all storage and resource checks still pass while producing a new `receiptId`; the same inspection can then bypass the semantic duplicate checks and be charged twice. Validate this field against a canonical value or exclude it from the semantic projection.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
